The all-in-one platform for comprehensive medical reviews

We solve the biggest problems with medical record reviews:
Time-consuming manual reviews

Speed up medical reviews with concise summaries and automation, freeing up time to focus on critical tasks.

Information overload and duplication

Cut through the noise with quick and accurate medical summaries tailored to your line of business that ensure no detail is missed and that irrelevant and duplicate information is suppressed.

Unstructured Data

Convert unstructured data into structured data, allowing for machine to machine processing to fully automate the process.

Transparency to the original source document

Enhance the accuracy of risk assessments with reliable, AI-enhanced analysis that provides click-to-evidence for easy verification. You are one click away from the truth, ensuring no black box.

Advanced Medical Record Reviews

Why DigitalOwl?

  • Speed and accuracy
    Reduce processing time for medical records by up to 72% while achieving 97% accuracy or higher.
  • Versatility in record types
    Quickly process any kind of record, including APSs, EMRs, lab results, prescription data, forms, and handwritten notes.
  • Page count reduction
    Deduplicate records and focus only on core summary pages with a 90% reduction in page count.
  • Superior customer support
    Maximize the use of AI-powered products with a tailored onboarding experience and access to comprehensive training resources.
